assessments.reasoning: The Go 1.23 receive rule determines both results. Once a closed channel is drained, the receive produces a zero of its element type and the status is false.

challenge.method: Consider a closed buffered channel holding one explicitly sent zero, then receive twice.
challenge.results: The first receive delivers the sent zero with true. The second produces zero with false. A nil channel instead blocks.

limitations: A closed channel can still contain previously sent values. A nil channel follows a separate rule.
The rule concerns a receive-capable channel and the two-result form. Readiness is a different property from successful delivery.
